summary: metrics-utility ships with the automation controller node on RHEL, needs an active subscription, and must run as root or awx because it reads /etc/tower/SECRET_KEY; other users get a PermissionError.
questions: Do I need to install metrics-utility separately on RHEL?
What are the prerequisites for metrics-utility?

answer_card.title: metrics-utility prerequisites on RHEL
answer_card.answer_md:
- Active AAP subscription
- Already installed on the automation controller node (no extra package)
- Run as `root` or `awx`: it needs read access to `/etc/tower/SECRET_KEY`
- Any other user fails with `PermissionError`
